privileged_info_for_vlm: The source data contains 53 survey stations. The final output must be an Excel file (.xlsx) located at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/sr99_mass_haul.xlsx. The calculations must follow the Average End Area method: Volume = [(Area1 + Area2) / 2] * Distance. The Net Volume is typically Cut minus Adjusted Fill. Cumulative Mass Haul is the running sum of the Net Volume.
